## Contribution checks

- [ ] The change does not depend on system fonts, network access, office binaries, ambient time, locale, or randomness.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior or the pull request explains why a test is impractical.
- [ ] Public behavior and compatibility documentation are updated.
- [ ] New fixtures and assets are redistributable, have documented provenance, and contain no personal or confidential data.
- [ ] This pull request does not disclose a security vulnerability; those are reported through private GitHub security advisories.
